objectives: Defend a bounded design and its failure behavior.

sections.title: Candidate brief
sections.markdown: Scale a public catalog service from500 to10,000 reads/s. Updates are infrequent, but users must see a confirmed update within30 seconds. Defend every new component, estimate capacity, and explain behavior during cache loss. Begin with the current simple service.

sections.title: Assessment workflow
sections.markdown: Use the interview center for the saved attempt. Ask clarifying questions, record actual evidence, and finish the answering phase before opening the separate debrief. Scheduled hour:45 minutes reasoning and15 minutes feedback/retry planning.

exercise.prompt: Scale a public catalog service from500 to10,000 reads/s. Updates are infrequent, but users must see a confirmed update within30 seconds. Defend every new component, estimate capacity, and explain behavior during cache loss. Begin with the current simple service.
exercise.solution: Reference reasoning is available through the interview debrief after submission.

mentalModel: Use observations to narrow the mechanism before adding capacity.
